fc_start_stop_reward_scope: The fixed one-cycle start-stop settlement remains in the complete physical ledger but is excluded from the learning reward because the current Actor does not control the physical on/off event. Action-dependent shutdown transient degradation remains included.
battery_equivalent_hydrogen_sign: Signed learning cost. Discharge is positive and charge is a negative valuation credit outside the physical ledger.
battery_equivalence: Zhou et al. Eq. (25)-(26), DOI 10.3390/jmse13010034. Use executed one-second battery bus power, calibrated battery efficiencies, fixed FC average efficiency and pre-action SOC.
training_selection: fixed Train voyage parent_005_seg01; 9258 one-second intervals; reset at t=0 with SOC=0.6 and FC=0 kW
evaluation_protocol: Deterministic fixed parent_005_seg01 every 20 episodes and full Validation8 every 100 episodes
